name: local-helper-ownership
goal: Every existing single-consumer helper lives beside its owning component, service or function while shared helpers, contracts and registered history remain intact.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Relocate all 412 baseline single-consumer helpers into owner-local folders. Preserve 392 shared helpers, implementation semantics, stable registered identities and source/history evidence. Migration ledger names each helper and owner.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing unit-index relocation coverage proves synthetic moves and identity retention but does not check the actual repository helper layout. Extend that standardized suite with the committed migration ledger, definition fingerprints and owner-folder assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 578aa361 fails the actual repository layout assertion: all 412 owner-local definitions are missing. Immutable red record 65d145e3ef765eb581f4ea5e10082f70fb5bf29f62dd23ef0a22893bb94d454c preserves the output.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
